description_html:
A rarely available penthouse (Type 35) with a large reception and dining room, three double bedrooms, a galley kitchen, two bathrooms each with a shower, and an exceptionally large terrace with views over the Barbican gardens, St. Giles Church and the City skyline. On entering the property, you are greeted with a double height reception room and a wall of windows facing east. The flat benefits from the morning sun. The lease has been extended.

Close to both St.Paul's and Farringdon stations with access to the Central Line, Elizabeth line, Circle and Hammersmith and City.

Tenure: Leasehold
Council Tax Band: G
